policy_title: Increase Pension Fund Investment in UK Markets
stated: Labour will implement reforms to encourage workplace pension schemes to consolidate and scale, aiming to increase their investment in UK markets. A review of the pensions landscape will be undertaken to further improve pension outcomes and boost UK market investment.

source.quote: Labour will also act to increase investment from pension funds in UK markets. We will adopt reforms to ensure that workplace pension schemes take advantage of consolidation and scale, to deliver better returns for UK savers and greater productive investment for UK PLC. We will also undertake a review of the pensions landscape to consider what further steps are needed to improve pension outcomes and increase investment in UK markets.

bearing_set.reason: The policy explicitly targets 'pension outcomes' through consolidation and scaling of workplace schemes, directly affecting the adequacy of retirement savings and retiree security.

Directing large-scale pension capital into UK equities, infrastructure and growth assets is a concrete mechanism for lifting domestic business investment and productivity, key O13 indicators — the stated UK-market investment goal is the channel.

membership_note: Two clear bearings: O8 for the pensioner-outcome side and O13 for the UK-investment/productivity channel. Other fundamentals (O12, O14, O11) are either too indirect or lack a concrete mechanism linking this policy to their specific indicators.
